description: Scaffold a Script CHOP/DAT/SOP/TOP with a ready-to-edit onCook(scriptOp) stub and optional custom parameters. Creates the Script op plus its companion callbacks DAT, writes a per-family stub (chan/row/point/numpy) — or your `on_cook_body` — and appends Float/Toggle/Str custom pars inferred from each default's type. Returns {op_path, callbacks_path, params_added, warnings}. Requires TDMCP_RAW_PYTHON=on and TDMCP_BRIDGE_ALLOW_EXEC=1. Note: Script ops only cook when something requests them, so a paused timeline + no downstream consumer means no cook (not a bug).

custom_params.description: Custom parameters to append on the Script op's 'Custom' page.

default.description: Initial value; type infers the parameter family (number→Float, bool→Toggle, string→Str).

name.description: Custom parameter name; normalized to a TD-legal identifier.

family.description: Script op family — selects the operator type and the onCook stub signature.

name.description: Name for the Script op; TD auto-names when omitted.

on_cook_body.description: Optional body for onCook(scriptOp); injected verbatim. When omitted a per-family no-op stub is used.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP to create the Script op inside.

name: author_script_operator
title: Author Script operator
